summary.headline: Virtuoso Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose about 85% YoY to INR 376.6 crore, with PAT up about 103% to INR 9 crore; FY27 guidance of 35-40% growth and 9-10% EBITDA margin maintained.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue was INR 376.6 crore, up about 85% YoY and about 18.7% QoQ, with EBITDA margin at about 9.3%, similar to Q4 FY26. PAT rose about 103% YoY to about INR 9 crore from INR 6.4 crore. Management said raw material (copper, aluminium, imported compressor inputs) and logistics pressure squeezed margins, with pricing expected to stabilise over the next couple of quarters. Commercial refrigeration was slower in Q1 as buyers deferred purchases after price hikes. Management kept FY27 guidance of 35-40% growth and 9-10% EBITDA margin, and said an upward revision depends on Q3.

financial_highlights.change: ~103% YoY vs INR 6.4 crore in Q1 FY26

financial_highlights.metric: Revenue mix Q1 FY27: deep freezers
financial_highlights.change: Similar to EMS; balance from components

segments.name: Room AC (ODM)
segments.commentary: About 70% of Q1 FY27 revenue; FY27 expected at 55-60% of revenue. Largest AC customer (Voltas) about 40-45% of AC segment, expected 25-35% in FY27; AC capacity going from 1.0 mn to 1.8 mn units over 12-15 months. Margins are under pressure; management expects improvement from FY28.

segments.name: Compressor
segments.commentary: Production began late Dec 2025 and runs at over 50% utilisation; capacity going from 2.8 mn to 6 mn, targeted Dec/Jan. Expected ~15% of FY27 revenue; EBITDA margin about 6-7% currently. Captive use only 2-3% of sales; works with 8-9 customers, with no single customer above 20-23% expected.

segments.name: Commercial refrigeration
segments.commentary: Q1 slower due to price increases and deferred buying; management says Q2-Q3 projections have been pushed out, not cut. Capex INR 20-25 crore this year; capacity 400,000 units, with a potential INR 360 crore revenue at 60% utilisation.

segments.name: EMS
segments.commentary: Capacity going from 4 lakh to 12 lakh cph; first 8 lakh cph phase expected by mid/end September, commercial production by end Q3. About 10% of FY27 revenue; little top-line impact this year, with revenue expected from FY28.

segments.name: Deep freezers
segments.commentary: Capacity going from 1.5 lakh to 2.5 lakh units by mid/end Q3 FY27; second phase to 4 lakh units in FY28.

segments.name: Components and washing machines
segments.commentary: Expected ~5% of FY27 revenue; Chennai and Sanand picking up. Washing machine work is mainly with one anchor customer this year.

guidance_outlook: Maintains FY27 revenue growth guidance of 35-40%; management said an upward revision depends on Q3 performance, with an update at end of Q3.
FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 9-10% maintained; management said Q1 margin of 9.3% is healthy and margins could move closer to 10% once pricing stabilises.
Net margin guidance of 2-3% (answering a 2.5-3% query), with tax timing noted.
Margin improvement expected mainly in FY28 as raw material pressure eases over 6-12 months.
Long-term ambition of 35-40% revenue CAGR over the next three to five years; peak revenue at current expansion estimated at INR 3,500-4,000 crore within 12 months.
Total FY27 capex INR 80-100 crore at VOEPL; commercial refrigeration capex INR 20-25 crore.
capex_capacity: EMS: 4 lakh cph moving to 12 lakh cph in two phases; first 8 lakh cph expected mid/end Sept 2026, commercial production by end Q3.
AC: 1.0 mn to 1.8 mn units in two phases (1.0 to 1.3, then 1.3 to 1.8) over 12-15 months; 27-28 season expected to utilise 50-60% of the increased capacity.

Compressors: 2.8 mn to 6 mn units, targeted Dec/Jan with commercial production by Q4 FY27; compressor utilisation target above 75% by next year; INR 500 crore total project, INR 150 crore raised via OCD, first phase funded by equity issue; 22-acre land bought for consolidation.
Deep freezers: 1.5 lakh to 2.5 lakh units by mid/end Q3 FY27; 4 lakh units in FY28.
Vertical capacity is generally expanded only after 50-70% utilisation for seasonal products and 70-80% for non-seasonal ones; new capacity needs 12-24 months to reach target utilisation.
demand_pricing: RAC industry growth expected at 8-10% in the coming season; management said prices have stabilised and inventory levels are normal.
Market is absorbing price hikes slowly in commercial refrigeration; B2B buyers deferred purchases in Q1.
Import restriction on compressors at 40% per government policy, expected to ease in 1-2 years; management sees this as an opening for market growth.
Raw material pressure (copper, aluminium, imported compressor components, logistics) persisted; PCB/chip cost impact limited so far.
PLI benefit worth about 1% of EBITDA, mainly in AC; management is negotiating with customers to share the impact over the next 12 months.
Customer concentration: top AC customer at over 60% in FY26, expected 25-35% in FY27; AC customer count is four.

qa_highlights.question: Will Virtuoso make AC compressors after the Voltas-linked startup win, and what is the plan for the 22-acre land?
qa_highlights.answer: Only refrigeration compressors are confirmed so far; no AC compressor plan has been finalised, and the 22-acre parcel is for consolidating the refrigeration compressor business at one location over 1-3 years.

qa_highlights.question: What underpins the 35-40% growth guidance, and how does it compare with the 43% CAGR over FY21-FY25?
qa_highlights.answer: Growth rests on high-growth AC and compressor verticals, first-mover advantage in compressors, the 40% import restriction easing over 1-2 years, and an AC order book; management said the market is growing 10-15% and value-add can drive 35-40%.

qa_highlights.question: Will AC margins improve as the ODM mix rises, and how do OEM and ODM margins differ?
qa_highlights.answer: Raw material pressure may persist for 6-12 months, with margin improvement expected mainly in FY28; OEM vs ODM margin difference is about 1-1.5 percentage points.

qa_highlights.question: Given Q1 growth, will FY27 guidance be revised?
qa_highlights.answer: Guidance is unchanged for now; Q1 and Q4 are the biggest quarters and a possible upward revision depends on Q3, with an update at end-Q3.

qa_highlights.question: What is the AC capacity utilisation outlook for FY28 and how much is from existing versus new customers?
qa_highlights.answer: Expected 50-60% utilisation of the increased capacity in the 2027-28 season, a combination of existing customer projections and new onboardings; full capacity live before that season.

qa_highlights.question: How is the INR 500 crore compressor project funded beyond the INR 150 crore raised?
qa_highlights.answer: The first phase is covered by the equity issue in progress, with INR 150 crore via OCD; the next phase's debt versus equity mix will be decided over the next 12 months.

qa_highlights.question: What is the commercial refrigeration capex, revenue potential, and the medium-term CAPEX plan?
qa_highlights.answer: No significant capex in Q1; INR 20-25 crore planned this year and a similar amount next year for the 400,000-unit capacity; at 60% utilisation revenue is about INR 360 crore, with another large capex needed beyond that.

qa_highlights.question: What is the compressor margin trajectory, and how much is captive versus external?
qa_highlights.answer: Compressor EBITDA is about 6-7% currently; captive use is 2-3% of sales, and margins could rise 1-2 points mainly in FY28 after backward integration. Sanand: about 15% of VPPL output goes to VOEPL, 85% to outside customers.

qa_highlights.question: How will the PLI benefit be passed to customers, and what are the peak revenue and net margin targets?
qa_highlights.answer: PLI is worth about 1% of EBITDA, mainly AC; talks with customers will conclude over 12 months. Peak revenue with the expansion is about INR 3,500-4,000 crore; net margin guidance is 2-3%.

risks_watch: Commercial refrigeration demand: Q1 was slower as B2B buyers deferred purchases after price hikes; management says Q2-Q3 projections moved out, not cut.
Raw material and logistics cost pressure (copper, aluminium, imported compressor inputs, dollar and shipping volatility) could keep margins at 9-10% through FY27 with improvement pushed to FY28.
Customer concentration: top AC customer (Voltas-linked) at 40-45% of AC segment, expected 25-35% of AC in FY27; compressor top customer expected to stay near 20-23%.
Execution on capacity ramp: EMS first 8 lakh cph phase due mid/end Sept 2026; compressor 2.8 mn to 6 mn units targeted Dec/Jan; new capacity needs 12-24 months to reach target utilisation.
Funding and leverage: OCD cost in the mid-teens; INR 80-100 crore FY27 capex; equity dilution and debt plan for later phases still undecided; interest cost rose about INR 1.5 crore QoQ.
PLI benefit ending and pass-through to customers over the next 12 months; PCB and chip cost impact not yet significant but present.
key_quotes: So overall, we had a good quarter. There was, of course, pressure on margins.
So, compressor as the government has currently restricted imports to 40% and hopefully this will reduce in the next year or two.
Depending on how Q3 effectively goes, we'll be able to see if we can upward revise the guidance.
So far I think 9.3% also we believe is a healthy number.
summary.management_tone: Confident on guidance and capacity build-out, but cautious on near-term margins and commercial refrigeration demand, which management tied to raw material pricing and deferred buying. Evasive on specifics such as second-largest AC customer names and exact AC compressor plans, and on the next-phase funding mix.
